proposed.text: The Right to Health (RA 7277 Sec. 23) requires accessible hospital toilets. What are the minimum clear internal dimensions of the accessible WC cubicle under BP 344 2024 Revised IRR?

options.text: 2000 mm wide x 2000 mm deep, with a 900 mm door that slides only
1500 mm wide x 1800 mm deep, with a 750 mm door that swings inward
1800 mm wide x 1800 mm deep, with a 900 mm door that swings outward or slides
1800 mm wide x 2250 mm deep, with a 900 mm door that swings out or slides

proposed.rationale: Correct answer: C — 1800 mm x 1800 mm minimum clear internal area with a 900 mm outward-swinging or sliding door. Source verbatim (BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, Appendix A, item 1, PDF p.36 line 1143): 'A minimum area of 1800 mm x 1800 mm.' The 2250 mm depth in option D is not in the source and is the documented error being corrected.
proposed.explanation: BP 344 2024 Revised IRR specifies a minimum area of 1800 mm x 1800 mm for the accessible toilet cubicle (Appendix A, item 1, PDF p.36 line 1143). The door must be 900 mm clear width and swing outward (or slide) so it is not blocked if a wheelchair user falls against it. The 2250 mm depth is NOT in the source. Lavatories, if provided inside, must be installed outside the 1800 mm x 1800 mm clear area (PDF p.38 line 1207).
